meta.note:
Section order: Chunk ID (always, 6 hex chars) → Wall time (4 decimals) → Process exited with code (only when exit_code is Some) → Process running with session ID → Original token count (always, Option in the wire but always Some in the real path) → Output: → body. Truncation: token-budget middle truncation with "…N tokens truncated…" plus "Warning: truncated output (original token count: N)
Total output lines: L

" prefix; the 1 MiB collection cap inserts "... N bytes omitted ...". DSH counterpart: renderExecResult(value).
